visa_requirement_type: Advance visitor visa required for Bangladesh ordinary passport holders, plus a separate visitor permit
maximum_permitted_stay: Visitor permit is normally up to 1 month when issued on arrival; an advance visitor-permit application can allow up to 6 months. Total visitor-permit duration, including extensions and previous permits, cannot exceed 9 months in any 12-month period. The immigration officer determines the period.
entry_count: Visa validity and entry count are determined on the individual visa; no standard validity or entry count is published. Visitor permit is a separate permission.
passport_validity_rule: Travel document must have sufficient validity to cover the intended stay; the Government recommends at least 6 months remaining at entry.
blank_passport_pages_rule: No blank-page count is specified in the published Form 1 or visitor-permit guidance.
return_ticket_rule: Provide proof of onward travel/return arrangements or sufficient funds to purchase a return ticket.
proof_of_funds_rule: Sufficient funds for the duration of the intended stay; no fixed minimum amount is published.
accommodation_rule: Pre-booked accommodation in the Islands is required for a visitor permit.
travel_insurance_rule: Adequate medical insurance for the full stay, including aero-medical evacuation, with minimum cover equivalent to USD 2,000,000.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: Form 1 requires disclosure of dangerous contagious disease history. No Bangladesh-specific vaccination list was identified in the cited visitor guidance; check current health rules if arriving from a yellow-fever-risk country.
transit_rule: Bangladesh is on the visa-required list. The FAQ lists an exemption for visa-national passengers/crew whose principal reason for landing is transit, including day-visit cruise passengers and crew. No ETA is required.
application_channel: Complete Form 1 and email it to permits@customs.gov.fk. Visa must be secured before visiting. A separate visitor permit is normally issued on arrival for stays up to one month; apply in advance for longer stays.
application_fee: GBP £80 per visa application from 1 July 2026; GBP £6 for each under-18 child included in another person's application. Visitor permit application and extension are GBP £0. Separate air embarkation tax is GBP £40 through 31 December 2026 and GBP £41 from 1 January 2027.
processing_time: No official visa decision processing estimate is published; contact Customs & Immigration and apply well in advance.
required_documents: Form 1 Application for Visa to enter the Falkland Islands, completed and emailed to permits@customs.gov.fk|Copies of all passports held|Proof of onward travel arrangements or sufficient funds to purchase a return ticket|Proof of pre-booked accommodation in the Falkland Islands|Proof of sufficient funds for the intended stay|Medical insurance for the full stay, including aero-medical evacuation cover of at least USD 2,000,000 equivalent|Declaration of all criminal convictions, cautions and fixed penalty notices, whether spent or not|Birth certificate copies for accompanying children where relevant

visa_requirement_type: Australian Visitor visa (subclass 600) Tourist stream required; no separate territorial visa
maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 12 months under the Visitor visa subclass 600, subject to the period granted in the visa notification and VEVO.
entry_count: Single or multiple entry as granted by Home Affairs; check the visa grant notification and VEVO.
passport_validity_rule: A valid passport or travel document is required. The general subclass 600 page does not prescribe an additional six-month post-departure validity period.
blank_passport_pages_rule: No fixed blank-page count is stated on the general subclass 600 Tourist stream page.
return_ticket_rule: Applicant must be a genuine visitor and have enough funds to support the stay and departure. Provide itinerary/return arrangements if requested; no universal requirement to buy a non-refundable ticket before grant is stated.
proof_of_funds_rule: Must have enough money to support the visit and leave Australia; no fixed minimum amount is published on the general Tourist stream page.
accommodation_rule: Provide the intended itinerary and accommodation information where requested by the personalised ImmiAccount checklist; no universal pre-paid hotel requirement is stated on the general page.
travel_insurance_rule: Home Affairs recommends health insurance for unforeseen medical treatment; remote-territory visitors should ensure their policy covers evacuation and travel disruption. Insurance is not stated as a universal subclass 600 visa condition on the general Tourist stream page.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: The territory travel page states no special vaccinations or medications are required for the island. Australian public-health entry requirements based on recent travel still apply.
transit_rule: Normal Australian immigration procedures apply when arriving from outside Australia. If transiting through mainland Australia, hold the appropriate Australian visa; a Transit visa subclass 771 is a separate route only where its eligibility conditions are met. There is no separate island transit visa.
application_channel: Apply online through ImmiAccount for Visitor visa subclass 600 Tourist stream while outside Australia and remain outside until decision. If a biometrics requirement letter is issued, book an appointment at an Australian Biometric Collection Centre in Dhaka, Chittagong or Sylhet; VFS captures a digital photo and fingerprints.
application_fee: Australian visa application charge is displayed by the official Visa Pricing Estimator at time of lodgement; amount is subject to change. Separate VFS biometric collection/service charges apply if requested and are shown for the selected centre.
processing_time: Use the official Visa Processing Time Guide for current indicative statistics; the guide reflects recently decided applications and is not a guarantee or a Bangladesh-specific service standard.
required_documents: Valid ordinary Bangladesh passport|Online Visitor visa subclass 600 Tourist stream application lodged through ImmiAccount while outside Australia|Evidence supporting genuine temporary visit and sufficient funds, as requested by the personalised ImmiAccount checklist|Travel itinerary and accommodation details where requested|Employment, business, study, retirement or sponsor evidence relevant to the applicant's circumstances|Biometrics and facial photograph at an Australian Biometric Collection Centre if Home Affairs issues a biometric requirement letter
